requirements.ruleText: Be a non-Chinese citizen in good health, hold a high-school diploma, and be age 16-30.
Sign in to OUC's International Students Service System, complete the online application and submit it before the deadline.
Submit a scan of the passport information page and a two-inch photograph.
Submit a notarized copy of the highest education degree and diploma.
Submit notarized academic transcripts.
Submit a personal resume.
Submit the Physical Examination Form.
Submit a non-criminal record certificate or relevant certificate.
Submit a financial statement.

Applicants from non-English-speaking countries: IELTS 5.5, TOEFL 80, equivalent English proof, an English-medium prior degree certificate, or at least one year of study in an English-speaking country.

Submit CSCA Mathematics. The acquired subject table lists Marine Sciences with Physics but does not use the English guide's Oceanography title, so no optional-subject equivalence is inferred; confirm the route-specific optional subject with OUC.

requirements.ruleText: Pay the published CNY 400 application fee.
The program opens only when enrollment exceeds 15 students.
Complete and submit the application before June 10, 2026.
Pay the published tuition for this route: CNY 23,000/year. The guide separately lists accommodation at CNY 5,500 per semester and insurance at CNY 800.
